outcome: Infant feeding mode at discharge and 4 months postpartum
cohort: Pregnant women (n=402) recruited from an Australian metropolitan hospital between August 2010 and January 2011
finding: While both healthy weight and overweight women had similar antenatal intentions for infant feeding, overweight mothers were less likely to be exclusively breastfeeding at hospital discharge and 4 months postpartum.
mod_finding: Overweight women were less likely to be exclusively breastfeeding at hospital discharge compared to healthy weight women, though both groups had similar antenatal breastfeeding intentions.
